unit.why: A short anecdote, reported by R. Yitzhak of Radoshitz (?) via 'ושמעתי', in which the Seer of Lublin's household delays his meal and he deliberately refrains from anger, plus that rabbi's Yiddish comment on it.
unit.boundary_note: Embedded in an ethical compilation on anger and pride; previous and next divisions are teachings on the same theme.

stories.start_quote: ושמעתי מפ״ק הגאון מוהרי״צ מראודל איך
stories.end_quote: משא ומתן ניט פרליכען. (ר״א אות י״א)
stories.summary_en: The Seer of Lublin asked his household to serve supper early so he could rise early for a great spiritual task; they served it even later, ruining his plan, yet he reasoned that his purpose was God's will and that God's will also forbids anger, so he did not grow angry.
